components._description: Self-built OpenSSL FIPS provider (CMVP #4282) - identical build recipe to the web image's (ossl-builder stage, pinned source); Postgres links the system libcrypto and inherits the activated provider. CPE added 2026-08-31 (req-cicd-sbom / tap#231): the purl is `pkg:generic`, which matches NO advisory feed, so the most compliance-significant binary in the image was invisible to every vulnerability scanner. CPE is the vocabulary NVD-backed matchers speak. VERIFIED against the live NVD API: this CPE returns 38 CVEs, of which 6 are other products (Mutt, OpenLDAP, mod_ssl) indexed under OpenSSL's CPE and most of the rest are in libcrypto/libssl code the FIPS provider does not contain — confirmed by inspecting the built fips.so (CMS/PKCS7/PKCS12/ASN.1/DANE/OCB symbols absent). So this field enables detection and REQUIRES triage: match on the CPE, then ask whether the vulnerable code is inside the FIPS module boundary before acting.
components.name: openssl-fips-provider
